name: props-table
title: Props table
description: An API reference table for docs: name, type, default, required and description, with nested object props that expand.
docs: Pass rows ({ name, type, defaultValue, required, description, children, group }). A union type breaks at its pipes, a required prop carries the word Required and a prop with no default says None. A row with children has a button that opens its fields beneath it, indented, to any depth; defaultExpanded opens some at the start. Every row has an id (prop-variant, or data-table-variant with idPrefix) and a link: opening the page at one opens what holds it, scrolls there and highlights the row. Below 42rem of width each prop becomes a block with its name on top, and the rows keep their table semantics for screen readers. labels translates every word.
